repository.name: spotitube
repository.description: Synchronize your Spotify collections downloading from external providers

head_repository.name: spotitube
head_repository.description: Synchronize your Spotify collections downloading from external providers

steps.code:
export PATH=$PATH:$(go env GOPATH)/bin
go install mvdan.cc/gofumpt@latest
if gofumpt -l -e . | grep '^' -q; then exit 1; fi

go test -v -timeout 30s -coverprofile=coverage.out ./...
go tool cover -func=coverage.out | grep -E '^total:.*100.0%$'
